changelog:
- Added a transition lerp between ADS states: `Weapons > ADS`. On by default.
- Added an option to make CJ naturally turn his body in the direction he is looking instead of rotating his body with the camera while standing still: `OnFoot > Switches > Natural Look Sides | Still`.
- Added an option to choose whether all new weapons should start with recoil enabled: `Weapons > Recoil`. On by default.
- Added an option to make the gun reloading process cinematic: `General > Cinematic > Reloading a Gun`. Off by default.
- Added `UltimateFP_IsADSActive()->bool` to the API.
- Added a new Global Multiplier for Recoil: ADS Active. `1.0f` by default.
- Added an option to make the sniper's shots shake the camera: `Weapons > General`.
- Fixed some bugs
